details.name: MOB.623_Collector_Saved_Photo_Menu
details.message: `MOB.623` **Add a photo to an EXISTING asset, then drive the gear menu on that SAVED photo; and what the Photos / Docs / Attributes panels render.** - Fixture is the newest `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE` asset in the collector list (`MOB.600` residue). It has no saved photo (measured 2026-09-09), so the test adds ONE through the panel's own `Add Photo` — a surface nothing else covers — and polls for the `blob:` preview to become a server URL before touching it. **Residue: one photo per run** on a throwaway record. In `MOB.994` this runs last, on the asset created a minute earlier. - ⭐ **`Rotate Image` ×4** — a real mutation with a read-back proof: the slide's `` must DIFFER from the value recorded before each click and carry a fresh `t=`. Four 90° turns are 360°, so it is **self-restoring by construction**. (The server swallows a failed `rotate()` and still returns, so this proves the round trip, not the pixels.) - ⭐ **The menu set is asserted exactly and in order**: `View in Fullscreen` · `Get Description` · `Set as Avatar` · `Rotate Image` · `Delete Photo`. Only Rotate is clicked; the others write, post to the AI route, or delete. - ⭐ **Photos vs Docs is a biconditional** — carousel + `Add Photo` and no `Add File`, then the exact opposite. Attributes is an exclusive-or over its two render branches. - Scoped to ONE accordion item and its LAST slide throughout (trap 3); leaves the row collapsed and removes its scratch `sessionStorage` key.
